text:
Nora (Docs): Starting a quick thread for a tiny PR: adding a short section on "burst_capacity" + prewarm pools in the Dedicated provisioning guide. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2522
Jin (Infra): Nice. Can we show both terraform and console examples? Terraform var should be `burst_capacity_enabled = true` in the sample.
Nora (Docs): Yep adding both. Also planning a short diagram showing how prewarm keeps KV caches hot for tail-latency sensitive workloads.
Paolo (SRE): Suggest a troubleshooting note: if prewarm tasks aren't scheduling, check node taints/tolerations and the prewarm job's affinity. Might be too detailed for user docs; keep it short.
Mira (Eng): Two small nits: the JS SDK snippet uses `maxBatch` while we standardized on `batch_limit` last quarter. Also the Python example still has `batch_size`.
Nora (Docs): Thanks — will normalize to `batch_limit` everywhere and add a one-liner: "SDK param name: batch_limit (replaces older maxBatch/batch_size names)".
alex (Product): Can we include a customer-friendly sentence about when to enable burst capacity? Something like: "Enable burst capacity for spiky traffic patterns where occasional higher throughput is preferred over strict cost control." Keep it non-technical.
Nora (Docs): Added that under the new "Burst & Prewarm" callout.
Paolo (SRE): CI found a broken link to runtime prewarm doc: `/internal/runtime/prewarm` -> 404. The correct path is `/runtime/prewarm-pools`.
docs-ci: Link check failed in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 94 -> /internal/runtime/prewarm (404)
Nora (Docs): Fixed the link to `/runtime/prewarm-pools`. Also added the terraform snippet showing `prewarm_replicas = 2` and `prewarm_schedule = "cron(*/5 * * * *)"` as an example.
Jin (Infra): tiny style nit in terraform sample: use `prewarm_replicas = 2 # recommended for small GPU pools` inline comment.
Mira (Eng): Can we add a short performance table example (rough numbers) showing first-request vs warmed-request latency to set expectations? e.g., 1st request ~ 120ms higher for cold KV on 512-token seqs. Small example is helpful.
Nora (Docs): Added a two-row example showing cold vs warm median latencies for 128/512-token sequences with a note "approx. numbers; actual varies by model and hardware".
pdocs-ci: lint and link checks queued
docs-ci: All checks passed for PR #2522
Nora (Docs): Merged after CI. Follow-up: will open an issue to add the new JS/Python snippets to docs-smoke so we don't regress param names again. Issue #478 created.
Mira (Eng): Thanks — will sync with SDK team to keep snippet templates up to date.
Paolo (SRE): One more follow-up suggestion: a brief note about using conservative `batch_limit` values for on-prem small pools (e.g., <=4). Not blocking this merge.
Nora (Docs): Noted; will include in the follow-up PR with expanded examples. Closing thread. Thanks!
